headline: NFL Week 5 MNF: Bills clash with Rams under SoFi lights in primetime duel
whyCareReason: Josh Allen leads Buffalo into Inglewood against Matthew Stafford and Puka Nacua to cap Week 5 after Sunday overtime drama.
teaser: Monday Night Football kickoff is 8:15 p.m. ET on ESPN and ABC from SoFi Stadium in Los Angeles.
story: Week 5 of the 2026 NFL season concludes with a blockbuster cross-conference showdown as the Buffalo Bills visit the Los Angeles Rams at SoFi Stadium on Monday Night Football. Josh Allen commands a high-flying Buffalo offense seeking to keep pace in the competitive AFC East race. Sean McVay's Rams welcome back key defensive pieces and look to lean on Kyren Williams and Matthew Stafford before a raucous California home crowd. After a Sunday slate featuring overtime finishes and undefeated runs, Monday night delivers the ultimate Week 5 exclamation point.
stakes: A Buffalo victory vaults them to 4-1 alongside the AFC elite, while a Rams win pulls Los Angeles into a tie atop the NFC West.
rivalryAngle: Two premier franchise quarterbacks duel in prime time under the multimillion-dollar canopy of SoFi Stadium.
funFacts: SoFi Stadium hosted Super Bowl LVI where Matthew Stafford and the Rams claimed the Lombardi Trophy.
Josh Allen has thrown at least two touchdown passes in six of his last seven Monday Night Football appearances.
The Minnesota Vikings and San Francisco 49ers stand at 5-0 while the Chiefs are 4-0 following Sunday results.

keyPlayers.name: Josh Allen
keyPlayers.hook: Dynamic playmaker capable of dominating games through both air and ground.

keyPlayers.name: Matthew Stafford
keyPlayers.hook: Veteran signal-caller orchestrating an offense that leads the NFC in red zone efficiency.

headToHead: Buffalo and the Rams have split their last four regular-season meetings.
resultSummary: UPCOMING: Bills at Rams, Monday 8:15 p.m. ET on ESPN/ABC at SoFi Stadium
